name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: The official requirement is to try each type of activity once. Exophase lists the bronze award, and GTABase includes it in the activity set. The supplied sources do not establish every activity name or location, so rely on the game menus and do not invent a list. Retain a cleanup save and recheck each category after one attempt. The trophy should award when the final distinct activity type registers as tried.
